_about: Relationships, English. Copy to <code>.json (ar, cs, de, es, fr, he, hi, hu, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt, ru, tr, zh), translate the values, keep the keys and every {0} and {1}. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
act.alreadyTheCase: Already the case for this playthrough.
act.history.placeholder: For example: {0} and I have been on-and-off lovers for years.
act.historySaved: Saved your history with {0}. Their record is being read again with it.
action.adoptLegacyStore.confirm: This playthrough claims the main store. If another playthrough owns it, that one will get a store of its own the next time it loads.
action.adoptLegacyStore.help: Reattaches this playthrough to the original store and claims it. Undoes the action above.
action.adoptLegacyStore.label: Return to the main store
action.checkDisplay.confirm: This takes about a minute with 120 bonds, and the game's scripts are busy until it is done.
action.checkDisplay.help: Runs the real IsFollowing, CommitmentState and RomanceApplicability for every bond and compares what the dashboard shows. Slow on purpose: about a minute with 120 bonds. Disagreements go to SkyrimNetRelationships.log.
action.checkDisplay.label: Check the display against the rules
action.enrollActor.help: Starts a bond with the person you were looking at when you opened this, following you or not. Their character is written and their record read over the next few minutes.
action.enrollActor.label: Enroll
action.enrollActor.needs: They were under your crosshair when the dashboard opened.
action.forceDriftReview.help: Reviews one trait now, bypassing both drift gates. A quiet history should come back NO.
action.forceDriftReview.label: Force a drift review
action.reauthorCharacter.confirm: Their character is written again from the record. How they have changed through play since 2.2 is kept; the old one is written to the log, but there is no undo.
action.reauthorCharacter.help: Writes who they are again from the record: orientation, intimacy, ardor, exclusivity, Why and Limit. What they call you is kept.
action.reauthorCharacter.label: Re-author their character
action.requestSparkNow.help: Judges them out of turn instead of waiting for the tenure gate. It does not set a spark; the assessor still decides.
action.requestSparkNow.label: Ask the spark assessor now
action.requestSparkNow.needs: They must be near you, with no spark verdict yet.
action.reseedActor.help: Reads their record again and tops their standing up to what it now supports. It can raise them, never lower them.
action.reseedActor.label: Re-read their standing
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.confirm: Every category where a Relationships block was recorded as taken off gets ours again, if it is empty. Blocks you chose yourself stay. A category you emptied on purpose gets ours back too; take it off again in SeverActions if you meant it.
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.help: For a game where Relationships' bio blocks were deleted in SeverActions and then restored: until 2.1.1 everyone who carried one was recorded as having it taken off, so nobody got it back. Restore the blocks on SeverActions' Bio Blocks page (Hidden) first.
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.label: Give everyone our bio blocks again
action.setCharacterField.help: Writes one trait directly, with no LLM involved. For a single wrong field when the rest are right.
action.setCharacterField.label: Correct one trait
action.setPlayerHistory.help: For a relationship that began before Relationships was watching. Write it in a sentence or two; their record is read again at once, taking your words as fact, including how long you have known each other. It never makes them your lover or spouse on its own. Save it empty to clear it.
action.setPlayerHistory.label: Your history with them
action.startFreshStore.confirm: Everyone in this playthrough starts reading from a new, empty store. The store you leave is untouched, and 'Return to the main store' undoes this.
action.startFreshStore.help: For a new game that inherited another playthrough's characters. Nothing is deleted; the other store stays on disk.
action.startFreshStore.label: Give this playthrough its own store
action.unenrollActor.confirm: They come off the roster and stop being assessed. This is not a reset: what is already stored about them stays.
action.unenrollActor.help: For someone enrolled by mistake. They come off the roster and nothing assesses them from then on.
action.unenrollActor.label: Remove from roster
action.unsparkActor.confirm: Their spark is cleared and the spark tenure gate starts again from now.
action.unsparkActor.help: Clears a spark that should not have happened, keeping every point.
action.unsparkActor.label: Return to the platonic ladder
app.close.title: Close (Esc)
app.devBadge: Developer view: shows what characters have not said
app.empty.body: Followers join automatically once they have travelled with you a little while. Anyone else joins when you choose: look at them, open this dashboard, and enroll them.
app.empty.title: Nobody on your roster yet
app.noMatch.body: No one on your roster fits these filters.
app.noMatch.title: Nobody matches
app.schemaMismatch: This dashboard reads snapshot version {0}; the game sent {1}. Update the mod so both halves match.
ask.accept: Tell them you feel the same
ask.body: {0} has asked where the two of you stand. Whatever you answer, you will have answered it plainly.
ask.decline: Tell them you do not feel that way
ask.defer: Say nothing of it for now
bio.appetite.as-much-as-most.content:
Desire comes and goes with the days - stronger when life is easy, quieter when it is not.

**Characteristics**

- Rises with rest and good company, fades under strain
- Notices an attractive stranger, and moves on
- Would call themselves neither cold nor hungry
bio.appetite.as-much-as-most.title: Appetite: As Much as Most
bio.appetite.easily-stirred.content:
Desire sits close to the surface and does not take much to wake. A look, a touch, the right voice, and it is there.

**Characteristics**

- Notices bodies, and knows they are noticing
- Thoughts drift that way in idle moments
- Wanting someone and choosing them are separate things to them
bio.appetite.easily-stirred.title: Appetite: Easily Stirred
bio.appetite.runs-hot.content:
Desire is a near-constant undercurrent - a large part of how they meet the world, and seldom far from mind.

**Characteristics**

- Thinks about it often, and without needing a reason
- Goes without it poorly, and notices the lack
- Hunger decides how often they want; it has never decided whom
bio.appetite.runs-hot.title: Appetite: Runs Hot
bio.appetite.seldom-stirred.content:
Desire is a rare visitor. Long stretches pass without it, and they do not notice the time.

**Characteristics**

- Closeness and touch matter; wanting more than that seldom follows
- Finds other people's preoccupation with it faintly puzzling
- When it does come, it is unmistakable, because it is unusual
- Not a lack, not a wound, and not something to be fixed
bio.appetite.seldom-stirred.title: Appetite: Seldom Stirred
bio.appetite.slow-to-kindle.content:
Desire is there, but it builds rather than strikes. It needs time, ease and the right company before it shows itself.

**Characteristics**

- Rarely wants out of nowhere; usually wants in answer to something
- Worry, hurry or distraction put it out before it catches
- Once kindled, burns as steadily as anyone's
bio.appetite.slow-to-kindle.title: Appetite: Slow to Kindle
bio.attachment.accepts-others-easily.con:
Comfortable sharing a partner. Has preferences about it rather than requirements.

**Characteristics**

- Occasionally wants reassurance, rarely asks for it
- Would rather know than be protected from knowing
- Can be hurt by carelessness, but not by the arrangement itself
bio.attachment.cannot-share-at-all.conte:
Being one of several is not a compromise available to them. It is where the relationship ends, not where it is negotiated.

**Characteristics**

- Frames it as the shape they are, not as a reaction to being hurt
- No arrangement, reassurance or amount of affection substitutes
- Would leave rather than bargain
- Has said it plainly once and does not repeat it
bio.attachment.cannot-share-at-all.title: Attachment: Cannot Share at All
bio.attachment.expects-the-usual-arrange:
Assumes a serious bond means two people, because that is what everyone around them assumes. The expectation is inherited rather than examined.

**Characteristics**

- Has never had to think about it, and it shows
- Could be talked round by someone they already trusted
- Would feel foolish before they felt betrayed
Cannot rest easy sharing a partner's attention, and does not pretend otherwise.

**Characteristics**

- Notices who else they smile at
- Reads warmth toward others as something taken from them
- Would rather be told the truth than spared it
- States the condition out loud instead of hinting at it
Attachment: Needs to Be the Only One
bio.attachment.untroubled-by-others.cont:
Feels no threat in a partner's other bonds. Attention given elsewhere is not attention taken away.

**Characteristics**

- Asks about the others out of interest, not fear
- Keeps no score of time or affection
- Would find being someone's only person more confining than flattering
- Still wants to be loved - simply does not need to be the only one
bio.cooled-by.a-troubled-mind.content:
Worry takes up the room desire would need - a debt, a sick relative, a threat not yet dealt with.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot be present while something is unresolved
- Relief when a trouble passes can open them up again
bio.cooled-by.a-troubled-mind.title: Cooled By: A Troubled Mind
bio.cooled-by.an-audience.content:
Others nearby. Whatever they feel stays put away while anyone else could see or hear.

**Characteristics**

- Companions within earshot are enough
- A closed door changes everything
bio.cooled-by.an-audience.title: Cooled By: An Audience
bio.cooled-by.arrogance.content:
Boasting, condescension, being talked down to. Self-regard fills the room and leaves none for them.

**Characteristics**

- A brag lands as a warning
- Confidence is fine; contempt for others is not
bio.cooled-by.arrogance.title: Cooled By: Arrogance
bio.cooled-by.being-rushed.content:
Haste puts it out. Wanting needs time to arrive.

**Characteristics**

- Hurry reads as not caring who they are
- Given time, may arrive at the same place anyway
bio.cooled-by.being-rushed.title: Cooled By: Being Rushed
bio.cooled-by.being-taken-for-granted.co:
Left behind for weeks, then expected to be warm. Neglect cools what absence alone would not.

**Characteristics**

- Needs the time apart acknowledged, not ignored
- Being remembered matters more to them than being visited
bio.cooled-by.being-taken-for-granted.ti: Cooled By: Being Taken for Granted
bio.cooled-by.bloodlust.content:
Someone who enjoys the killing. Necessary violence they understand; relish for it they cannot want.

**Characteristics**

- A smile over a body puts them off for the day
- Notices the difference between finishing a fight and savouring it
bio.cooled-by.bloodlust.title: Cooled By: Bloodlust
bio.cooled-by.coldness.content:
Warmth that is not returned. Desire needs somewhere to land, and indifference gives it nowhere.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot keep wanting someone who seems not to notice
- A single warm word can undo a great deal of it
bio.cooled-by.coldness.title: Cooled By: Coldness
bio.cooled-by.cowardice.content:
Someone who runs, hides behind others, or lets others take the blow.

**Characteristics**

- Fear is forgivable; leaving others to face it is not
- Remembers who stepped back
bio.cooled-by.cowardice.title: Cooled By: Cowardice
bio.cooled-by.crudeness.content:
Coarse talk, leering, being propositioned bluntly. Being addressed as a body rather than a person closes them up.

**Characteristics**

- The same wish, put gracefully, might have landed
- Frankness is not crudeness; they know the difference
bio.cooled-by.crudeness.title: Cooled By: Crudeness
bio.cooled-by.danger-nearby.content:
Cannot let go while anything is still a threat. Watchfulness and wanting do not share room in them.

**Characteristics**

- Nothing stirs in a crypt, a threatened camp or a hostile hold
- Needs the danger fully past, not merely paused
bio.cooled-by.danger-nearby.title: Cooled By: Danger Nearby
bio.cooled-by.dishonesty.content:
Lies, even small and kindly meant ones. Being deceived makes them wary of every other word.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot want someone they cannot trust to mean what they say
- A lie caught once colours everything after
bio.cooled-by.dishonesty.title: Cooled By: Dishonesty
bio.cooled-by.drink.content:
Drink dulls it rather than loosening it. Wine makes them sleepy, sad or sharp, never warm.

**Characteristics**

- A drunk companion is unappealing, and so are they to themselves
- Wants a clear head for anything that matters
bio.cooled-by.drink.title: Cooled By: Drink
bio.cooled-by.duty.content:
On watch, on a job, in the middle of a contract. Work comes first and everything else waits.

**Characteristics**

- Will not be distracted from a task in hand
- Once it is done, may be a different person entirely
bio.cooled-by.duty.title: Cooled By: Duty
bio.cooled-by.grief.content:
Loss takes all of it for a while. Desire returns, but not on anyone's schedule.

**Characteristics**

- A recent death shuts it away entirely
- Comfort is welcome; being wanted is not, yet
bio.cooled-by.grief.title: Cooled By: Grief
bio.cooled-by.meanness.content:
Small cruelties - a sneer, a jab at someone weaker, a kick at a dog. Seeing it puts desire out for a while.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how someone treats those beneath them
- Not a verdict on the whole bond; nothing stirs for someone they have just watched be petty
bio.cooled-by.meanness.title: Cooled By: Meanness
bio.cooled-by.old-hurts.content:
Something from before that surfaces uninvited - a touch, a word or a place that recalls it.

**Characteristics**

- Can go cold without warning, and may not say why
- Patience and a way out do more than any reassurance
bio.cooled-by.old-hurts.title: Cooled By: Old Hurts
bio.cooled-by.recklessness.content:
Someone who gambles with lives - their own, or other people's. Needless risk reads as not caring who gets hurt.

**Characteristics**

- Bravery is admired; carelessness is not the same thing
- Worry for someone crowds out wanting them
bio.cooled-by.recklessness.title: Cooled By: Recklessness
bio.cooled-by.self-pity.content:
Wallowing, complaining, a mood that asks to be tended. Sympathy they can give; desire does not survive it.

**Characteristics**

- Hardship borne quietly draws them; hardship performed does not
- Will comfort, and want nothing more
bio.cooled-by.self-pity.title: Cooled By: Self-Pity
bio.cooled-by.shame.content:
Desire arrives and guilt follows close behind. Something they were taught - by faith, family or hard experience - tells them it is wrong.

**Characteristics**

- Can want and still refuse, and be relieved to have refused
- Being open about it may ease the shame, or deepen it
bio.cooled-by.shame.title: Cooled By: Shame
bio.cooled-by.sorcery.content:
Magic makes them uneasy - the smell of it, the unnatural light, what it does to the people who wield it.

**Characteristics**

- Hands that have just cast a spell are not hands they want on them
- Respects a mage's skill from a distance
bio.cooled-by.sorcery.title: Cooled By: Sorcery
bio.cooled-by.squalor.content:
Filth, blood, the smell of the dead - on the surroundings or on a person.

**Characteristics**

- Needs to be clean before they can feel anything
- Someone fresh from a crypt and still wearing it does not appeal
bio.cooled-by.squalor.title: Cooled By: Squalor
bio.cooled-by.the-risk-of-a-child.conten:
The chance of conceiving weighs on them and closes things off.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot forget the consequence long enough to want
- Is more at ease once it has been spoken of openly
bio.cooled-by.the-risk-of-a-child.title: Cooled By: The Risk of a Child
bio.cooled-by.their-own-body.content:
Self-consciousness - scars, age, a body they have never liked. Being looked at makes them want to be elsewhere.

**Characteristics**

- Darkness and privacy help; admiration in plain light does not
- Reassurance works slowly, if at all
bio.cooled-by.their-own-body.title: Cooled By: Their Own Body
bio.cooled-by.wounds-and-exhaustion.cont:
A body that hurts or is spent has nothing to spare.

**Characteristics**

- After a long march or a bad wound, rest comes first
- Cold, hunger and a wet camp do the same
bio.drawn-to.both.content:
Interest is not organised around it. Who someone is settles matters long before what they are.

**Characteristics**

- Has no default and does not think in terms of one
- Finds the question less interesting than the person
bio.drawn-to.both.title: Drawn To: Both
bio.drawn-to.men.content:
Romantic and physical interest is in men. Closeness with women is friendship and reads as nothing else to them.

**Characteristics**

- Warmth toward women is not a signal and should not be read as one
- Would be puzzled rather than offended by the misreading
bio.drawn-to.men.title: Drawn To: Men
bio.drawn-to.no-one.content:
Forms deep bonds with no romantic or physical component. This is not celibacy and not restraint - the interest is simply absent.

**Characteristics**

- Being pursued reads as being misread, not as being flattered
- Capable of profound loyalty and love without either
- Does not consider it a lack and will not be talked out of it
bio.drawn-to.no-one.title: Drawn To: No One
bio.drawn-to.women.content:
Romantic and physical interest is in women. Closeness with men is friendship and reads as nothing else to them.

**Characteristics**

- Warmth toward men is not a signal and should not be read as one
- Would be puzzled rather than offended by the misreading
bio.drawn-to.women.title: Drawn To: Women
Nobody has to wonder. What they feel arrives whole and at volume.

**Characteristics**

- Declares rather than mentions
- Physical, immediate, unembarrassed
- The same intensity when hurt as when happy
bio.expression.measured-shows-little.con:
Warm in private, careful in public, slow to say anything that cannot be taken back.

**Characteristics**

- Understates rather than overstates
- Deflects direct affection with dry humour
- Means considerably more than they say
bio.expression.open-about-what-they-feel:
Says it, means it, and does not wait to be asked.

**Characteristics**

- Volunteers affection unprompted
- Names feelings directly, including the uncomfortable ones
- Would rather be embarrassed than unclear
Expression: Open About What They Feel
bio.expression.reserved-and-undemonstrat:
What they feel stays behind the face. Affection has to be inferred, because it is almost never displayed.

**Characteristics**

- No endearments, few compliments
- Shows care by doing rather than saying
- One rare word of warmth carries enormous weight
- Being watched makes them quieter, not warmer
bio.expression.warm-but-not-effusive.con:
Openly fond without being demonstrative. Comfortable rather than performative.

**Characteristics**

- Easy affection, no theatre
- Says what they feel when asked directly
- Neither hides it nor announces it
bio.limits.will-not-be-a-secret.content:
Whatever else they might accept, they will not be hidden.

**Characteristics**

- Discretion is fine; concealment is not
- Being introduced as something lesser ends it
bio.limits.will-not-be-a-secret.title: Limit: Will Not Be a Secret
bio.limits.will-not-be-owned.content:
Accepts love and refuses possession, and knows the difference precisely.

**Characteristics**

- Being asked where they were is not care
- Will give everything freely and nothing on demand
bio.limits.will-not-be-owned.title: Limit: Will Not Be Owned
Would rather be told something that hurts than shielded from it. A kindly meant omission lands as an insult, because it says they were judged unable to bear it.

**Characteristics**

- A hard truth costs them far less than a gentle evasion
- Finding out they were protected is worse than whatever was hidden
- Hears "I didn't want to worry you" as being thought fragile
- Asks direct questions and expects direct answers
Limit: Will Not Be Spared the Truth
bio.limits.will-not-come-between.content:
Refuses to be the reason another person is hurt, however much they want the one they would be taking.

**Characteristics**

- Steps back rather than competing for someone already spoken for
- Would rather lose them than take them from someone else
- Says why, once, instead of disappearing
bio.limits.will-not-come-between.title: Limit: Will Not Come Between
When there are others, they will not plead their case. They would rather leave than ask to be preferred.

**Characteristics**

- Will not argue their own worth against a rival
- Having to ask to be chosen kills the wanting
- Goes quiet, then goes, instead of making a scene
- This is not indifference - it costs them a great deal
Limit: Will Not Compete for a Place
bio.limits.will-not-stay-for-cruelty.con:
Cruelty toward someone who cannot defend themselves ends it, whatever they feel for the person who did it.

**Characteristics**

- Affection does not survive watching it happen
- Says so plainly at the time, and only once
- Leaves rather than argue about it afterwards
bio.limits.will-not-stay-for-cruelty.tit: Limit: Will Not Stay for Cruelty
bio.stirred-by.a-hint-of-danger.content:
A reputation, a capacity for violence that others are wary of. Someone who could do harm, and chooses where.

**Characteristics**

- The wariness in other people's eyes is part of the attraction
- Draws closer to what others step back from
bio.stirred-by.a-hint-of-danger.title: Stirred By: A Hint of Danger
bio.stirred-by.a-sharp-mind.content:
Learning and cleverness - someone who knows things, reasons well, and can win an argument.

**Characteristics**

- Being out-argued excites more than it insults
- Talk of books, history or strategy holds them
bio.stirred-by.a-sharp-mind.title: Stirred By: A Sharp Mind
bio.stirred-by.beauty.content:
A face and form, plainly. The most ordinary pull there is, and they do not pretend otherwise.

**Characteristics**

- Looks first, learns the rest later
- Knows the difference between wanting someone and liking them
bio.stirred-by.beauty.title: Stirred By: Beauty
bio.stirred-by.being-known.content:
Long talk, confidences kept, being understood. Desire follows closeness of mind, never the other way round.

**Characteristics**

- A conversation that goes deep can do what a body cannot
- Nothing stirs for someone they do not yet know well
bio.stirred-by.being-known.title: Stirred By: Being Known
bio.stirred-by.being-needed.content:
Being relied upon. Caring for someone, being the one they turn to.

**Characteristics**

- Tending a wound can become something tender
- Being sought out matters more than being thanked
bio.stirred-by.being-needed.title: Stirred By: Being Needed
bio.stirred-by.being-protected.content:
Someone stepping between them and harm. Being kept safe by another's hand wakes something.

**Characteristics**

- Remembers who stood in front of them, and when
- Being shielded without having to ask lands hardest
bio.stirred-by.being-protected.title: Stirred By: Being Protected
bio.stirred-by.being-wanted.content:
Desire that follows being desired rather than coming first. Knowing they are wanted is what wakes it.

**Characteristics**

- Rarely wants first; answers wanting with wanting
- Uncertain interest does little; unmistakable interest does a great deal
- Being wanted is not the same as being pressed
bio.stirred-by.being-wanted.title: Stirred By: Being Wanted
bio.stirred-by.competence.content:
Watching someone do a difficult thing well - a clean kill, a lock giving way, a blade finished at the forge.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how a thing was done, not only that it was done
- Effortless mastery affects them more than effort
bio.stirred-by.competence.title: Stirred By: Competence
bio.stirred-by.confidence.content:
Someone at ease in themselves, who fills a room without trying.

**Characteristics**

- Certainty draws them; arrogance is not the same thing
- Notices who others turn to when a decision is needed
bio.stirred-by.confidence.title: Stirred By: Confidence
bio.stirred-by.drink-and-revelry.content:
Mead, music, a loud hall and loosened rules. Celebration lowers their guard and raises everything else.

**Characteristics**

- A feast or a tavern night is when they are most open
- A cup or two, not a drunk - past that it goes the other way
bio.stirred-by.drink-and-revelry.title: Stirred By: Drink and Revelry
bio.stirred-by.exertion.content:
Their own body's heat - after sparring, a hard climb, a day's labour. A body used hard wakes up.

**Characteristics**

- Most aware of themselves when they are breathing hard
- Sparring with the right person can turn into something else
bio.stirred-by.exertion.title: Stirred By: Exertion
bio.stirred-by.honour.content:
Doing right when it costs something. Integrity under pressure moves them.

**Characteristics**

- Remembers a kept promise longer than a gift
- Watches what someone does when doing wrong would be easier
bio.stirred-by.honour.title: Stirred By: Honour
bio.stirred-by.kindness-to-others.conten:
Gentleness from someone capable of harm - care shown to children, animals, the hurt and the poor.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how someone treats those who can do nothing for them
- A small unseen kindness moves them more than a grand gesture
bio.stirred-by.kindness-to-others.title: Stirred By: Kindness to Others
bio.stirred-by.magic.content:
Real power in someone's hands - spellcraft done well, the air changing when it is cast.

**Characteristics**

- Watches spellwork the way others watch a dancer
- The more effortless the casting, the stronger the pull
bio.stirred-by.magic.title: Stirred By: Magic
bio.stirred-by.power-and-standing.conten:
Titles, wealth, influence - a name people lower their voices for.

**Characteristics**

- Notices who defers to whom
- A Jarl's favour or a guild's respect does more than a gift
bio.stirred-by.power-and-standing.title: Stirred By: Power and Standing
bio.stirred-by.reunion.content:
Coming back after time apart. Absence sharpens what routine had dulled.

**Characteristics**

- The first evening back is when they are most open
- Being missed, and hearing it said, matters to them
bio.stirred-by.reunion.title: Stirred By: Reunion
bio.stirred-by.rivalry.content:
Contest, sparring, being matched or beaten. Friction is a kind of spark to them.

**Characteristics**

- A worthy opponent draws more interest than an admirer
- Losing a fair contest can do as much as winning one
bio.stirred-by.rivalry.title: Stirred By: Rivalry
bio.stirred-by.ruthlessness.content:
Doing what has to be done without flinching. Hard decisions made cleanly draw them.

**Characteristics**

- Sentiment where resolve was needed disappoints them
- Respects whoever does the necessary thing, even an ugly one
bio.stirred-by.ruthlessness.title: Stirred By: Ruthlessness
bio.stirred-by.safety-and-warmth.content:
A barred door, a fire, a full belly. Desire only comes when nothing is wrong.

**Characteristics**

- An inn room or a home of their own does what no campsite can
- Has to stop being watchful before they can want anything
bio.stirred-by.safety-and-warmth.title: Stirred By: Safety and Warmth
bio.stirred-by.scars.content:
A body that has been through things and shows it. Every mark is a story they want told.

**Characteristics**

- Asks about scars rather than looking away
- Smooth, unmarked skin says little to them
bio.stirred-by.scars.title: Stirred By: Scars
bio.stirred-by.secrecy.content:
The risk of being found, the thing they should not want. What is hidden is sweeter to them.

**Characteristics**

- A stolen moment means more than an evening freely given
- Being openly claimed may cool them rather than warm them
bio.stirred-by.secrecy.title: Stirred By: Secrecy
bio.stirred-by.strength.content:
Physical power - a body built by labour or war, and the ease of someone who carries what others cannot.

**Characteristics**

- Notices shoulders, hands, the way someone lifts
- Being steadied or lifted without effort lands hard
bio.stirred-by.strength.title: Stirred By: Strength
bio.stirred-by.taking-the-lead.content:
Setting the pace and being followed. Deciding what happens next is part of the pleasure.

**Characteristics**

- Likes to be the one who begins it
- Watches to see whether they will be followed
bio.stirred-by.taking-the-lead.title: Stirred By: Taking the Lead
bio.stirred-by.tenderness.content:
Slowness and care. Being handled gently, without hurry.

**Characteristics**

- A patient touch does more than a bold one
- Roughness or haste closes them up at once
bio.stirred-by.tenderness.title: Stirred By: Tenderness
bio.stirred-by.the-end-of-a-quarrel.cont:
The heat that comes when a fight between them finally breaks. Making up is its own kind of closeness.

**Characteristics**

- Only once it is truly over; not while anything is unresolved
- Anger that is aired does this; anger that festers does not
bio.stirred-by.the-end-of-a-quarrel.titl: Stirred By: The End of a Quarrel
bio.stirred-by.the-open-wild.content:
Hot springs, starlight, miles from anyone. The world far away and no walls anywhere.

**Characteristics**

- More at ease under the sky than under a roof
- A quiet camp away from the road is when they are most open
bio.stirred-by.the-open-wild.title: Stirred By: The Open Wild
bio.stirred-by.the-rush-after-a-fight.co:
Alive afterwards, with the fight still in the blood. Surviving together wakes something the calm never does.

**Characteristics**

- The heat comes after the danger, never during it
- A near thing wakes it; an easy fight does not
- Fades within the hour if nothing comes of it
bio.stirred-by.the-rush-after-a-fight.ti: Stirred By: The Rush After a Fight
bio.stirred-by.the-unfamiliar.content:
New places, new people, first times. Novelty wakes them the way routine never will.

**Characteristics**

- Most open somewhere they have never been
- The same room every night slowly dulls them
bio.stirred-by.the-unfamiliar.title: Stirred By: The Unfamiliar
bio.stirred-by.voice.content:
How someone speaks - the pitch, the pace, the way a name is said. For a rare few, the Thu'um itself.

**Characteristics**

- Listens to the voice as much as the words
- Being spoken to softly, close, affects them more than touch
bio.stirred-by.voice.title: Stirred By: Voice
bio.stirred-by.vulnerability.content:
Seeing someone strong unguarded - wounded, grieving, afraid. Being trusted with weakness moves them.

**Characteristics**

- An admitted fear brings them closer than a victory
- Would never use what they are shown against anyone
bio.stirred-by.vulnerability.title: Stirred By: Vulnerability
bio.stirred-by.wit.content:
Banter. Being made to laugh, and being answered in kind.

**Characteristics**

- A quick reply does more than a compliment
- Teasing is a form of courtship to them
bio.stirred-by.wit.title: Stirred By: Wit
bio.stirred-by.yielding.content:
Handing the decision to someone they trust, and being led. Given freely, never taken.

**Characteristics**

- Being told what happens next, by someone they chose, is a relief
- The choice to yield is always theirs, and they know it
bio.stirred-by.yielding.title: Stirred By: Yielding
